title: SchwingCheck: from seven measures to a named field
caption: The bodies in view, every place between C3 and L5 they could occupy, the likelihood of each place from Panjabi's means and spreads with one shared size factor, and the posterior: a name at 0.99, a region or border claim, or "cannot say".
